title: Spatiotemporal immune zonation of the human kidney

materials_reviewed.notes: Full text parsed from PDF and review_md. Spatio-temporal immune zonation and mononuclear phagocyte subsets reviewed.
Renal tissue dissociation, flow cytometry, scRNA-seq library prep, and spatial zonation scoring reviewed.
Fig. 1 (kidney immune atlas), Fig. 2 (immune zonation), Fig. 3 (MNP clusters), Fig. 4 (pelvic epithelium & bacterial defense) reviewed.
Supplementary Figures S1-S21 and Supplementary Tables thoroughly checked.

context_only.notes: Canonical markers utilized for identifying kidney parenchymal epithelial cell contamination and anatomical reference.

excluded.reason_excluded: 未决项查证排除：SLC12A1 属于肾脏髓袢升支粗段 (TAL) 已知教科书标志物，本文为肾脏免疫细胞时空分区研究，其实质细胞标志物仅用于背景图谱对照，缺乏本文独立的新发现证据。总表 audit_exclusions 已裁决排除，转入 context_only 留痕。
未决项查证排除：AQP2 为集合管主细胞先验经典标志物，本文研究重点为免疫微环境，总表 audit_exclusions 已裁决排除其实质细胞候选资格。
未决项查证排除：SLC12A3 为远曲小管经典标志物，总表 audit_exclusions 已排除。
未决项查证排除：NPHS2 (Podocin) 为肾小球足细胞经典标志物，总表 audit_exclusions 已排除。

coverage_summary.audit_notes: Resolved pending questions: SLC12A1, AQP2, SLC12A3, NPHS2 categorized as excluded/context_only canonical parenchymal reference markers per audit_exclusions. Formal candidates focused on MNP subclusters and pelvic epithelium. Aligned with all 18 verified candidates in our_markers.xlsx.
